subject: prd/docgate
statement: When invoked as `check-projection-congruence` with a merge base, docgate shall evaluate every newly added amendment at its own immediately-before and immediately-after replay boundary and fail each after-only disagreement between a binding projected unit and its source-map record: missing on either face, non-live-but-rendered, live-but-absent, current-location drift, contract-field drift, or disagreement between the ID cell's human-visible lineage and machine lineage.
rationale: deterministic generation can repeat two mutually inconsistent artifacts; the gate must prove agreement at the entry that changed them
fit_criterion: each named mismatch class has an isolated red fixture; a same-ID mutation hidden in a section supersede is red; two added entries attribute only their own delta and name the actual inconsistent artifact plus the causative entry
